partnershipPlan: Staff council representatives review the information sheet and data rules; two patient representatives review the alert policy for shared bays; ward managers join the steering group without access to individual data.
socialListening: No social media listening; comments on the staff intranet thread about the badge system are summarised without names.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: If my badge buzzes in front of a patient, it feels like being told off in public.
items.implication: Keep alerts discreet and report only ward-level data.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I work on four wards a week; nobody tells me which ones are in the study.
items.implication: Record float status and brief float staff separately.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Something kept buzzing near my bed every time the nurse came in at night.
items.implication: Track night alerts as a balancing measure.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We signed up to ward numbers, not to anyone being named.
items.implication: Restate JSC-2026-07 in the protocol and information sheet.

summary: Four composite voices on surveillance, float staff, patient sleep and the data agreement.
